request.description:
Set the default custom hostname for a specific app and service (registry, proxy, download portal, or replicated app).
The default hostname is used when no other custom hostname is specified for a channel.

Required RBAC Policy: kots/app/[:appid]/customhostname/default/set

response.name: SetDefaultHostnameResponse contains whether or not the request was successful
Returned on bad input
Return if the caller is not authorized
Returned if the caller does not have the needed permission
Returned on resource not found

request.description:
Remove the default custom hostname for a specific app and service (registry, proxy, download portal, or replicated app).
After unsetting, the system will fall back to the replicated hostname for that service if a custom hostname is not set for a channel.

Required RBAC Policy: kots/app/[:appid]/customhostname/default/unset

response.name: UnsetDefaultHostnameResponse contains whether or not the request was successful
Returned on bad input
Return if the caller is not authorized
Returned if the caller does not have the needed permission
Returned on resource not found
